name: Hut Booking
description: A three-step booking card for a mountain hut: nights on a range calendar, guests and meals, then confirm, with an itemised summary that updates as you choose and a hut stamp on the booking.

props.name: hut
props.description: The hut: { name, region, altitude (metres), image?, currency? (ISO code, default "JPY"), prices: { bunk, child?, dinner, breakfast, lunch }, open?: { start, end } (ISO dates of the season), booked?: string[] (ISO dates of full nights, shown struck through), cancelDays? (free cancellation ends this many days before arrival, default 3) }. Prices are per person per night; child falls back to bunk.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial choices: { start, end (ISO dates), adults (default 2), children (default 0), dinner (default true), breakfast (default true), lunch (default false), guest }. Make another booking returns to these.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the booking is confirmed, with { reference, hut, start, end, nights, adults, children, meals, guest, lines, total }. lines is the itemised price list shown in the summary.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Other section props are passed through. Below about 640px of width the summary moves under the steps.
